summary: Invardia now sees long-running jobs clearly, and health reports arrive even when one part is refused.

new.title: Long runs reported to Invardia
new.text: While a job runs, Invardia sees which job, since when, and how its length compares with normal.

new.title: Health reports always arrive
new.text: If Invardia refuses one part of a health report, the rest is sent again without it.

fixes.title: Small databases are now enlarged
fixes.text: 2.0.57 did not enlarge an existing smallest-size database. Running the install now does.
